CREATE INDEX i0 ON t0(c1, c1 + 1 DESC)
SELECT MIN(t0.c1), t0.c0 FROM t0 WHERE t0.c1 ISNULL

CREATE VIEW v0(c0, c1) AS 
      SELECT t0.c1, t0.c0 FROM t0 WHERE CAST(t0.rowid AS INT) = 1
